_comment: MiniMax H3 Image-to-Video. The MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo node (105:104) carries the prompt inline and takes an input image as its first_frame (LoadImage 114) plus an OPTIONAL last_frame keyframe (LoadImage 121). first_frame is fed the shot's beauty-pass still (needs_still); last_frame is an optional reference pick. Node ids use the '105:NN' subgraph-namespaced form from the ComfyUI export — they are plain string keys.
